description: This PHP class defines a configuration handler for a documentation website generator, providing methods to access and modify various configuration options such as site title, author, theme, directories, language settings, and content extensions.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Handles configuration settings for the documentation generator, including site details, directory paths, language, mode, and other advanced settings, with methods to retrieve and set these values.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the documentation site.

methods.name: hasAuthor
methods.description: Checks if an author is specified in the configuration.

methods.name: hasTagline
methods.description: Checks if a tagline is set.

methods.name: getCurrentPage
methods.description: Gets the current page content object.

methods.name: setCurrentPage
methods.description: Sets the current page content object.

methods.name: hasTimezone
methods.description: Checks if a timezone is set.

methods.name: isMultilanguage
methods.description: Checks if multiple languages are enabled.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the current mode (live or static).

methods.name: isLive
methods.description: Checks if the documentation is in live mode.

methods.name: isStatic
methods.description: Checks if the documentation is in static mode.

methods.name: shouldInheritIndex
methods.description: Determines if index inheritance is enabled.

methods.name: getIndexKey
methods.description: Returns the index filename based on mode.

methods.name: getHTML
methods.description: Returns an HTMLConfig object for HTML-specific settings.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on current configuration.

methods.name: hasTranslationKey
methods.description: Checks if a translation key exists for a given language.

methods.name: getTranslationKey
methods.description: Retrieves a translation string for a given language and key.

methods.name: hasImage
methods.description: Checks if an image is set.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for the site.

methods.name: getBasePage
methods.description: Returns the base page URL, considering mode and URL settings.

methods.name: hasEntryPage
methods.description: Checks if an entry page is specified.

methods.name: hasRequest
methods.description: Checks if a request path is set.

methods.name: hasProcessorInstance
methods.description: Checks if a processor instance is stored.

methods.name: hasHost
methods.description: Checks if a host is specified.
